description: Execute a swap: fresh estimate → create → local sign → execute. Does NOT use the transfer relay. Irreversible once submitted — no second confirmation. Returns operationId and txHash; poll with get_swap_status.

amount.description: Sell amount as a positive decimal string (zero and negative are rejected). Required unless maxMode.

address.description: Token contract address. Omit/null for the native coin.

decimals.description: Token decimals. If omitted, resolved via SWP catalog (paged). Prefer passing decimals (+ address for tokens) from list_swap_assets.

network.description: Network id of the asset to sell, e.g. ethereum, bsc, bitcoin.

symbol.description: Symbol of the asset to sell, e.g. ETH, USDT.

symbol.description: Symbol of the asset to buy, e.g. ETH, USDT.

name: execute_swap
title: Execute swap
